name: avegancafe
description: Kyle's personal Claude plugin: a home for one-offs that don't warrant their own plugin. Ships the work-notes-vault skill (his private Obsidian work vault and its Granola meeting archive), the side-quest skill plus a Stop hook (when Claude defers an out-of-scope finding, it offers to fork the session into a named background session that fixes it in its own worktree of the affected repo), and a session-title mod that keeps session titles in `type(Scope): imperative summary` form, refined as the work grows.
